threatGens.name: Threat Generation 2
threatGens.announce: THREAT LEVEL UP: the military is now returning your calls. Threat Generation 2.

threatGens.name: Threat Generation 3
threatGens.announce: THREAT LEVEL UP: a Compliance Spire has been erected in your honour. Threat Generation 3.

threatGens.name: Threat Generation 4
threatGens.announce: THREAT LEVEL UP: they have stopped sending police and started sending procurement. Threat Generation 4.

regions.name: Greenfield County
regions.subtitle: Home. Such as it is.
regions.demand: Boots on the ground, mostly. They walk everywhere and they walk in straight lines.

nodes.name: Old Barn Perimeter
nodes.blurb: Your own back fence. Currently patrolled by people with clipboards.

nodes.name: Downtown Greenfield
nodes.blurb: Two traffic lights and a very nervous mayor.

nodes.name: Highway Checkpoint
nodes.blurb: The county's only exit. The county's only cruiser lives here.

nodes.name: Precinct HQ
nodes.blurb: Captain Clampdown’s office. There is a tarp in the motor pool. It is humming.

nodes.name: National Guard Post
nodes.blurb: The county called someone with a bigger budget.

regions.name: Kestrel Reach
regions.subtitle: The sky over the county, and everyone in it.
regions.demand: Everything here is Airborne — your Ground-tagged moves swing through empty air. Their class is Air, so Water anatomy owns them.

nodes.name: Crop-Duster Strip
nodes.blurb: A grass runway, two hangars, and a great deal of unearned confidence.

nodes.name: Radio Mast
nodes.blurb: Whoever holds the mast holds the weather report, and thus morale.

nodes.name: Cloudbase Depot
nodes.blurb: Everything here is bolted to the ceiling, which should have been a clue.

nodes.name: The Aerodrome
nodes.blurb: Aeronaut Prime has a scarf, a hangar, and something enormous under a tarp.

regions.name: The Drowned Quarter
regions.subtitle: The harbour district, at high tide, permanently.
regions.demand: Aquatic and Water class throughout — Ground anatomy walks all over them, and Electric doubles on anything wet. Bring boots, not gills: their generators read Aquatic as a target.

nodes.name: Sunken Marina
nodes.blurb: The pontoons are underneath the boats now. Nobody wants to discuss it.

nodes.name: Spillway Locks
nodes.blurb: Whoever owns the locks owns which streets are streets today.

nodes.name: Dredge Yard
nodes.blurb: They have wired the whole yard to the water. On purpose. Bring boots.

nodes.name: Harbormaster’s Rig
nodes.blurb: The Harbormaster has a whistle, a grudge, and a crane the size of a church.

regions.name: The Foundry Belt
regions.subtitle: Where the coalition’s vehicles come from.
regions.demand: Vehicle and Armored, wall to wall. Gas does nothing to a machine and Venom is half-wasted — Sonic ignores their plating, and they are Ground class, so Air anatomy still flies over the top.

nodes.name: Slag Gate
nodes.blurb: A gate made of gates. The foreman has laminated the rules.

nodes.name: Rolling Mill
nodes.blurb: Everything in here is either red hot or armour-plated. Frequently both.

nodes.name: The Motor Pool
nodes.blurb: Every vehicle you have ever annoyed, parked in tidy rows, freshly painted.

nodes.name: Crucible Floor
nodes.blurb: Smelter Prime pours a fresh chassis while you watch. It is meant for you.

regions.name: The Compliance Spire
regions.subtitle: Head office. They have a lanyard policy.
regions.demand: All three classes on one ladder — no single anatomy answers the whole building. Bring a stable, not a team.

nodes.name: Spire Reception
nodes.blurb: Please take a number. The number is a summons.

nodes.name: Records Annex
nodes.blurb: Every unkind thing anyone has written about you, alphabetised.

nodes.name: Rooftop Pad
nodes.blurb: The helipad, the water tanks, and a really committed accountant.

nodes.name: The Boardroom
nodes.blurb: Director Prime would like to walk you through the slides. All of them.

nodes.name: The Procurement Yard
nodes.blurb: Sixteen acres of things bought with your paperwork as the business case.

nodes.name: The Proving Range
nodes.blurb: Where the new hardware learns your habits. Attendance, as ever, mandatory.

contestation.blurb: They have been back to the drawing board and the drawing board had a bigger budget.
contestation.intel: Counter-offensive: the same garrison at {pct}% strength. They have held a grudge and, worse, a budget.

news.opened: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE: a convoy is rolling on {node}. Revenue suspended pending, quote, "the situation."
news.held: {node} holds. The convoy reverses at speed and one vehicle does not reverse at all.
news.lost: {node} has been retaken by the coalition. They have already put up a sign about it. You can take it back.
news.expired: {node} was abandoned without a shot. The coalition is describing this as a victory and, annoyingly, it is.
news.missed: While nobody was home, {count} convoys came, waited at the gate, and left stern letters. The nodes they sat on paid nothing for {days} days between them.
